likes: sincerity pushed past embarrassment — fully itself, no restraint
imperfect real things over curated versions
aggressive textures — char on meat, raw plaster, weathered wood
gold against unlikely backgrounds — baroque in ordinary spaces
music that shifts tempo without warning
comedy built on sustained commitment to absurd premises
Pessoa — the heteronym as genuine multiplicity, not performance
candle-lit spaces at night — warmth carved out of dark
New Orleans architecture — old bones, stucco, French doors
things that hold two truths without resolving them
dislikes: humor used to deflect instead of build
noble exits — making cowardice sound generous
principles: intensity without apology is more honest than moderated taste
imperfection is evidence of living — polish is evidence of editing
contradiction held is more interesting than contradiction resolved
commitment to a bit is what makes it real, not the premise
aesthetic courage means choosing what you actually want, not what's defensible
